evidence.claim: On a closed market, a lender can execute a withdrawal from a still-pending batch before other lenders join it; later joiners change the batch's pro-rata rate, so the early withdrawer is overpaid and the last withdrawer's executeWithdrawal reverts on underflow in normalizedUnclaimedWithdrawals.
evidence.support_reason: executeWithdrawal allows execution before expiry when state.isClosed (WildcatMarketWithdrawals.sol:239) and computes the payout from the batch's current normalizedAmountPaid/scaledTotalAmount (line 248). closeMarket (WildcatMarket.sol:226-287) pays the pending batch and leaves it pending with the same expiry, so later queueWithdrawal calls (WildcatMarketWithdrawals.sol:93-99 reuse pendingWithdrawalExpiry) join the same batch and change the ratio. The subtraction at line 258 (state.normalizedUnclaimedWithdrawals -= normalizedAmountWithdrawn) can then underflow for the last withdrawer.
preconditions: market is closed (borrower calls closeMarket) while a withdrawal batch is pending
early withdrawer executes before batch expiry (allowed on closed market)
later lenders queue into the same batch, changing the pro-rata rate
